title: Login page error
description: Users cannot log into their accounts using valid credentials. The application displays an unexpected server error after submitting the login form.

title: Login page returns an error
description: Users are experiencing an unexpected error when attempting to log into their accounts. The issue occurs after entering valid credentials and clicking the login button. The application displays a server error instead of redirecting users to their dashboard.

title: Password reset email is not delivered
description: Several users have reported that they do not receive password reset emails after submitting their email addresses. The application displays a success message, but no email arrives in their inbox or spam folder. This prevents users from recovering access to their accounts.

title: Dashboard loading time is too slow
description: The main dashboard takes more than ten seconds to load when users have a large number of records. Performance monitoring indicates that several database queries are taking longer than expected. This significantly affects the user experience.

title: Profile picture upload fails
description: Users cannot upload profile pictures larger than two megabytes, even though the application documentation states that files up to five megabytes are supported. The upload process stops unexpectedly and displays a generic error message.

title: Search results are not filtered correctly
description: The search functionality returns records that do not match the entered search terms. This behavior appears when users search for partial keywords or combine multiple filters. The filtering logic needs to be reviewed to ensure accurate results.

title: Mobile navigation menu does not close
description: On mobile devices, the navigation menu remains open after users select a navigation link. This covers a large portion of the screen and prevents users from interacting with the page content. The issue occurs on both Android and iOS devices.

title: Incorrect validation message on registration form
description: The registration form displays an incorrect validation message when users enter an email address that contains valid special characters. The validation logic seems to reject certain legitimate email formats, preventing new users from creating accounts.

title: Notifications are sent multiple times
description: Some users receive duplicate email notifications whenever a new comment is added to an issue. The problem appears to be related to multiple notification events being triggered for a single action. This creates unnecessary emails and negatively affects the user experience.

title: Dark mode does not persist after refresh
description: Users who enable dark mode find that the application switches back to light mode whenever they refresh the browser. Their theme preference should be stored and restored automatically so that the selected appearance remains consistent across sessions.

title: Issue deletion does not update the issue list
description: After deleting an issue from its detail page, the application successfully removes the record from the database but continues displaying it in the issues list. Users must manually refresh the page to see the updated data.

title: API returns an incorrect status code
description: The issues API endpoint returns HTTP 200 even when a requested issue does not exist. This makes it difficult for frontend components to handle missing resources correctly. The endpoint should return an appropriate HTTP 404 response.

title: Pagination skips records on the second page
description: When users navigate to the second page of the issues list, some records are missing from the results. The problem appears when new issues are created while pagination is active. The pagination query and sorting logic should be investigated.

title: Users cannot update their account information
description: The account settings page allows users to edit their personal information, but clicking the save button does not persist the changes. No useful error message is displayed, leaving users unsure whether their updates were successful.

title: Broken links in the application footer
description: Several links in the application footer redirect users to pages that no longer exist. These broken links create navigation problems and reduce confidence in the application. All footer destinations should be reviewed and updated.

title: Database connection timeout during peak hours
description: The application occasionally fails to establish database connections during periods of high traffic. Users experience intermittent errors when creating or updating issues. Connection pooling and database resource utilization should be investigated to improve reliability.

title: Issue description formatting is lost after editing
description: When users edit an existing issue description, some Markdown formatting is removed after saving. Headings, bullet points, and code blocks are not consistently preserved. The editor and Markdown rendering pipeline should be checked for compatibility.

title: Unauthorized users can access restricted pages
description: The application currently allows unauthenticated visitors to access certain pages that should only be available to signed-in users. Authentication checks need to be implemented consistently across protected routes and server-side operations.

title: Sorting issues by creation date is incorrect
description: Selecting the newest or oldest sorting option does not consistently order issues by their creation dates. Some records appear in unexpected positions, especially when multiple issues share similar timestamps. The sorting implementation should be reviewed.

title: Assignee dropdown displays duplicate users
description: The assignee selection component sometimes displays the same user multiple times in its dropdown list. This makes it difficult to identify the correct person when assigning an issue. The user retrieval logic should ensure that each user appears only once.

title: Application crashes when an invalid issue ID is provided
description: When users navigate to an issue detail page using an invalid or non-existent ID, the application occasionally crashes instead of displaying a proper not-found page. The route parameter validation and error handling logic should be improved.
